citations.quote: For now, I want to deepen my work in data products.
I accepted the product engineer role at Riverstone Labs.
I do my best focused work remotely.
This month I feel exhausted after the launch.
My current goal is still to build reliable health tools.
The deadline may be 2026-12-06, though I need to confirm it.

statements: The user's career goal evolved throughout 2026, reflecting a shift from initial objectives to more focused aspirations. Initially, the user expressed a desire to 'build reliable health tools' (claim_6bf31ecd4ecba169d4df41c7276112d64e67b121861870ea7510f2f0e62ce253), which was later reiterated as a relocation plan. By mid-2026, the user mentioned a project deadline of '2026-12-06' (claim_5a3fc79cd548dfa66f285efa6e5ba2680c4860db6058d6e7d649fd3a5c28b6e8) with uncertainty about its accuracy. Later in the year, the user emphasized their role as a 'product engineer' (claim_a4378ac4cfc4b528ee0fb6024ed4adc121cb0035a0ba904f29833a5a5a68916e) and work preference for 'data products' (claim_666e70bf68ccbcff8fcb98bf26affce4a7f25050fdf9d9044f3270023d1e6deb). The user also mentioned feeling exhausted (claim_421465b0569ba6891d59c16f6efdbdf090e44beb3c0c17041fd8f8ee714a858f) and living remotely (claim_5328785925943677e1c4ba59f7fa36e74e7994d26869a909f648c14efc3afaf0).
